q: are the projections for the week for each team considering injuries? Seems like they may not be? Though I could be wrong. Track changes for my team as well as the other during the week and let me know if there are things they added or updates that changed their projection. Can you edit the app from here?
short: Yes, the weekly projections do account for injuries: OUT and IR players project to 0 and day-to-day players are discounted. I can't edit the app from here, but the data already stores a start-of-week baseline you can compare against.
answer:
Injuries are in the projection. In fetch.py each player gets an availability factor: OUT, IR and suspended = 0, doubtful = 0.3, questionable or day-to-day = 0.85. The lineup optimizer only considers players with availability above 0 for each remaining day, so an OUT player contributes nothing. In your data, Anthony Edwards and Ja Morant (both OUT, on IR) show 0 projected points this week, and Norman Powell (day-to-day) is discounted to 83.8 over 3 games. Your 1641.0 projection is 399.0 already scored plus 1242.0 still to come.

Why it may look off: the projection uses each player's season-long ESPN projection nudged toward actual scoring, not recent form. It uses the injury status ESPN shows at each refresh (every 30 minutes), so a late scratch or a status change after the refresh won't show until the next one. It also treats day-to-day players as playing at 85 percent rather than predicting a specific sit-out. Teams that leave OUT players in starting slots (WNBA Enjoyers have Porzingis OUT in an F slot; White Johnson has Barnes and Holmgren OUT in starting slots) correctly lose that value in the projection.

Changes since Monday's baseline (the app saves each team's projection at the start of the matchup week; today's number includes live scores): Garebears 1574.1 to 1641.0 (+66.9). Shake and Blake 1560.9 to 1490.3 (-70.6). Nifty Neighbas 1732.3 to 1681.1 (-51.2). Trash pandas 1584.0 to 1525.4 (-58.6). WNBA Enjoyers 1660.1 to 1483.8 (-176.3). Creamy Cropmen 1314.9 to 1507.0 (+192.1). Angel Reese 1988.1 to 1970.1 (-18.0). Commode Chokers 1700.9 to 1758.6 (+57.7). Jacob's Globetrotters 1496.9 to 1579.0 (+82.1). White Johnson 1469.9 to 1305.6 (-164.3). The big drops line up with OUT players in lineups (WNBA Enjoyers lost Porzingis and Demin; White Johnson lost Barnes, Holmgren, Butler and Ingram). Creamy Cropmen's jump is likely a mix of projection shifts and lineup changes, but I can't split those out because the data holds only the Monday baseline and the current number, not a log of each add or injury update.

Can I edit the app from here? No. In this setup I can read the league data and write only this answer file, so I can't change the dashboard code. A per-change tracker would need fetch.py to save a snapshot at each refresh and diff rosters and injuries between snapshots. That would be a good separate code change to request.
